description: Repairs r-wire/chunk-ole-append: Field.FieldSize was invoked as a method (the call kind), refused with 0x800A0CB3 on all rows, so the size question is unanswered. FieldSize is now read with a property get. On a dynaset of SELECT ID, FOle FROM W over a read-write copy of r-wire-blank: thirteen rows each AddNew, ID = n, Field.AppendChunk of the given Arg(s), Update, DBEngine.Errors read right after: 1 bytes 00 00 01, 2 empty array, 3 four zero bytes, 4 BSTR of 3 odd bytes, 5 BSTR "AB", 6 three arrays in sequence, 7 Null, 8 Empty, 9 Missing, 10 I4, 11 R8, 12 a 256-byte array, 13 Boolean. Then each row re-read through FindFirst with NoMatch, FieldSize (property get, Errors after) and GetChunk(0, 300), and the table read once. Asks per row the HRESULT of AppendChunk and Update, the FieldSize, and the stored bytes.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-wire-ado probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
